summary: Full Playwright E2E frontend test of Oasis Sultan Console v1 at 1920x800. All 4 panels visible with correct data-testids, WebSocket link active, auto-tick observed within 6s (cycle 48->52, energy changed, coins 53->54), Swarm Command Center processes valid ('revive all', 'boost 20') and invalid ('foobar' -> [ERR]) commands, KCU Validator returns vacuum_resonance 0.382802 with magic const 0x5F3759DF plus full T45 readouts, Sultan-Coin Ledger grew from 3137.5640/2077 mints to 3149.6050/2086 mints in ~12s, agent-cell-5 transitioned to dead styling (border #1c1c1c, score '--') after 'kill 5' and back to alive (border #00ff41) after 'revive all'. Layout renders clean at 1920x800 with no page or console errors (only expected 400 from foobar command).
critical_code_review_comments: useSultanSocket: WebSocket reconnect logic is fine but doesn't clear reconnect timeout inside onclose before scheduling a new one; if unmount races with reconnect a stale timer could fire (minor).
SwarmCommandCenter merges localLog with WS status.log via slice(0,60) - duplicate log lines can appear briefly when the WS echoes back the just-sent command; consider dedupe by timestamp/id.
SultanCoinLedger flash effect keys off c.id from mintFeed set; if id collides with existing rows the flash briefly highlights old rows (acceptable, low priority).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend verified 22/22 by main agent. Frontend fully verified via Playwright: all testids in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/console.js resolve correctly; WS ticks visible every 2s; command roundtrip, KCU compute, ledger mint growth, and kill/revive agent-cell state transitions all functional. Backend URL: https://resonance-vault-2.preview.emergentagent.com. WS endpoint: wss://.../api/ws.
